received: DT2 R0 and coach C2.1; both source workstreams preserved
conflict_received: LT1 main frame collides with DT2 at zero yaw. LT2 initial low-frame candidate would also collide; not published as cleared.

revision.body_status: Higher deck and3800mm cab roof envelope are integration proposals, not a completed revised shell. LT1 overall3400mm height is not valid for this alternative. Route clearances, ingress, CG/stability and appearance require revision.

clearance_screen.formula: Ztruck <= Zpivot + Rmax(sin|pitch| + sin|roll|) + heave; all modeled DT2 vertices at or below pivotZ1170. Relative yaw does not increase Rmax.
clearance_screen.scope: A conservative bounding-plane check for the provided DT2 solids at assumed ±2deg roll/pitch and +40mm relative lift; yaw unrestricted for this vertical bound only. Nominal DT2 pose treated as static reference.
clearance_screen.excludes: New bearing/sidebearer/retention stack bridging the gap; truck gearboxes, hoses, brakes, guides, springs/axleboxes, bodywork, pilot, steps, couplers and leading/trailing running gear. This is not route-curving or suspension acceptance.

mass_reconciliation.note: 2200kg is a new budget, not actual finished mass. Remaining allowance must cover motors, reduction, brakes, suspension and other omissions; adequacy unproved. 12000kg locomotive total retained for sensitivity.

coach_return: C2.1 retains1040kg seating allowance per regular coach; no complete coach tare or train mass reduction accepted.
